_crawl.about: Sunrise Medical Laboratories. We put people first. For over 40 years, we at Sunrise Medical Laboratories have consistently provided our member physicians and their patients with the most accurate and diagnostically meaningful results possible. Our success stems from our commitment to three essential principles. Courtesy Whether you're a physician or a patient, your needs are our top priority. We are committed to providing prompt service, timely notice of appointments and results, and empowering our employees with the answers to any questions you may have. Compassion We know that medical testing can sometimes be worrisome or stressful. For this reason, we train our staff to provide information, care and comfort whenever needed. Whether it's distracting a child during a blood draw or explaining a complex test, we're glad to go the extra mile for each and every patient. Professional Expertise We continually invest in the most advanced technologies so that we can provide the highest quality medical laboratory services available. We are fully licensed and accredited by The College of American Pathologists (CAP), New York State Department of Health, the Center for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CLIA), U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (Medicare), and the Pennsylvania Department of Health. Because your well-being, comfort and peace-of-mind are utmost to our success, we are proud to say, "We take it personally”.

## Healthcare Professionals

Committed to helping you enhance your practice and the experience of your patients through connected
devices and digitalised data sharing.

[Healthcare Professionals][9]
* [ Primary Care ][10]
  
  Supporting every aspect of your clinical practice, including physical exam, diagnostic cardiology,
  vitals monitoring and vision screening
* [ Hospital Care ][11]
  
  Advancing products and technologies designed to speed patient recovery and streamline clinical
  workflows
* [ Surgical Care ][12]
  
  Delivering innovations that enable reduced operating times, faster patient recovery and improved
  outcomes
* [ Nutritional Care ][13]
  
  Personalizing nutritional care designed to improve patients’ health in the hospital, the ICU and
  at home
* [ Respiratory Health ][14]
  
  Helping your patients with respiratory therapies designed to simplify delivery and improve
  mobility
* [ Our Products & Services ][15]
  
  Our portfolio of acute, nutritional, hospital and surgical care products helps advance healthcare
  around the world.

## Perspectives

For nearly a century, we have worked at the intersection of saving and sustaining lives.

[Perspectives][16]
* [ Patients' Stories ][17]
  
  Patients’ journeys inspire our work and drive our commitment.
* [ Healthcare Insights ][18]
  
  We’re engaging with industry thought leaders to explore how science and innovation advance
  healthcare.
* [ People of Baxter ][19]
  
  We are a community of diverse professionals working together to drive better healthcare options.
* [ Community Engagement ][20]
  
  Enriching the communities where we live and work.

## Our Story

Our 90-year heritage gives us distinct perspective on the needs of patients and caregivers. We lead
today by putting those insights to work to deliver new, better healthcare solutions and access to
care in the communities where we live and work.

[Our Story][21]
* [ Our Leadership ][22]
  
  Our forward-looking leadership team is a driving force in ensuring we meet the needs of all our
  stakeholders – every day and everywhere.
* [ Our Governance ][23]
  
  We are proud of our strong commitment to maintaining the highest standards of corporate
  governance.
* [ Fueling Collaborative Innovation ][24]
  
  Nurturing a culture of innovation is critical to delivering on our mission to save and sustain
  lives. We partner with the healthcare community to continually find more efficient, smarter ways
  to help solve the world's most pressing healthcare challenges.
* [ Baxter Sustainability ][25]
  
  We strive to create lasting value by delivering sustainable healthcare, advancing climate and
  resiliency, and championing our people and communities.
* [ Inclusion & Diversity ][26]
  
  We are committed to attracting, motivating and retaining an inclusive and diverse workforce.
* [ Our History ][27]
  
  For nearly a century, we’ve been focused on saving and sustaining lives and elevating patient
  care.

## Patients

Helping you reach a healthy life, full of possibility.

[Patients][28]
* [ General Healthcare ][29]
  
  Whether you are receiving care in the hospital, at your doctor’s office or at home, we are here to
  support every step of your journey.
* [ Nutritional Care ][30]
  
  When medical conditions prevent you from adequately feeding yourself, we provide life-saving
  clinical nutrition options to help you regain your nutritional status.
* [ Respiratory Health ][31]
  
  We are committed to helping you with innovative products that deliver effective, proven
  respiratory therapy in the hospital and at home.

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

about **beds** and **mattresses**, including the importance of a mattress, the components of a bed,
how to judge the quality of a mattress, and how to find the bed or bedding that is right for you.
With the change over in ownership and management, we now focus on bringing you [mattress
reviews][55] with real mattress ratings from unbiased customers like yourself. With features like
our **free members only bed discount buying club, expert reviews and customizable comparison
charts** of products you choose to evaluate, as a shopper, you really have the tools at your
disposal to make the best choice with your mattress and bed purchasing needs. Our reviews and
ratings include mattress reviews from a wide variety of brands, such as Sealy, Simmons, Serta,
Spring Air, Tempur-pedic, Select Comfort and much more! We also made sure we chose many different
models that incorporate in these mattress reviews all types of sleeping surfaces such as memory
foam, latex mattresses, spring mattresses, airbeds, and waterbeds.

## Bed and Mattress Shopping Made Easy!

Our industry experts have been assembled to provide a clear and concise way of evaluating the
current beds on the market, so the consumer can make an educated choice when
purchasing the best mattress, bed-set, or bedding accessories for their situation.  We have no
affiliation particular brand, so you get them all in one place!  When you combine this with our
discount buyers club and personal beds and mattresses concierge service (a new personal service that
guarantees you the best price on any mattress or bed you choose), as well as our customizable bed
and mattress comparison chart, you will have all the tools you need to make the smartest mattress or
bed shopping decision.

sign-up as a member, you can make notes that will be stored with each mattress review on our
customizable mattress and bed comparison table, so you can always come back to this chart and

# World-class science. Life-changing impact.

Get an inside look at the work we do every day to define what's possible and transform patients'
lives through science.

[ see what drives us ][68]

## Life + Science

[ view more stories ][69]

## Areas of focus
* [
  
  ### Oncology
  
  Building on our heritage in the treatment of solid tumors, we’re solving complex scientific
  problems for cancer patients everywhere.
  
  Learn more about Oncology ][70]
* [
  
  ### Hematology
  
  Known for delivering many transformational firsts in hematology, we’re committed to breaking new
  ground across diseases with high unmet need.
  
  Learn more about Hematology ][71]
* [
  
  ### Neuroscience
  
  We’re dedicated to championing the needs and experiences of people living with neurological and
  psychiatric diseases through disease-modifying and symptomatic therapies.
  
  Learn more about neuroscience ][72]
* [
  
  ### Immunology
  
  We’re working to deliver meaningful solutions that address unmet needs in dermatology,
  gastroenterology, pulmonology and rheumatology.
  
  Learn more about immunology ][73]
* [
  
  ### Cardiovascular
  
  Building on a 70-year legacy of paradigm-changing medicines, we’re leveraging our experience and
  expertise to take cardiovascular research to the next level.
  
  Learn more about cardiovascular ][74]

# Welcome to Disability Hoist Hire

Welcome to Disability Hoist Hire, the patient lifting equipment rental and training specialists.
Disability Hoist Hire offer **short** and **long** term **hoist hire** - a cost effective way to
meet your **manual handling needs**. **Hoist training** can also be provided for individuals or
groups by our specialist manual handling advisory team.

[Learn More][9] OR [Our Hoists][10]

## Social Care

The health and social care sector are amongst the highest risk areas for back injuries at work.
Approximately half of all accidents reported in these sectors happen to workers assisting or moving
individuals with mobility problems. Manual handling injuries are, however, preventable. Our
specialist advisors will be able to provide you with assistance whilst choosing your hoist.

[Risk and Danger Icon]

## Prevent Risks

Individuals with mobility problems are heavy and unpredictable loads and, therefore, workers
handling patients with mobility problems are covered by the Manual Handling Regulations 1992. These
Regulations say that employers **MUST:** Avoid manual handling wherever possible, Assess the risks
and reduce them as far as is reasonably practicable.

## Testimonials

Since discovering the Disability hoist hire service, I’ve gained my independence to go out of the
house and enjoy living again.

Joe, Berkshire

I no longer feel like I’m confined to my house. Now I have the freedom to stay in hotels knowing I
have easy access to the equipment I need to ensure I’m transferred safety.

Mandy, Lancashire

I’m so grateful to this service for giving me my life back!

Sarah, East Lothian

We have used "The Disability Hoist Hire" service for a number of guest speaker events within the
University and have great confidence in the service they provide. It is important to us that we can
provide access and cater to the needs of all individuals.

Mohammed, Manchester University

The disability hoist hire service means we can run events that are accessible to all individuals.
It’s highly rewarding when we receive a special request to know we can cater to their needs. The
disability hoist hire recommend the best type of hoist available for the individual and provides
outstanding expert knowledge.

Jill, Events Co-Ordinator, Story Events

As a private service we hope to think we can offer the highest standard of care for all our
patients. Thanks to the disability hoist hire service we can ensure we have the most suitable hoist
in place for our patients. Thanks to the flexibility of this service we can renew length of hire to
meet our patients length of stay.

Aria, The Priory

As a case manager, I find this service highly effective and it ensures I can provide the
physiotherapists or occupational therapists involved in the rehabilitation of my client with
adequate equipment they require to meet the level of support for my patients changing needs. The
flexibility in the equipment hire means I can easily adjust the equipment to meet the needs of the
patient through their rehabilitation.

Nick, Case Manager, HCML

## How Doty Belt Reduces Back Injuries

The Doty Belt is an ergonomic patient lift assist that significantly reduces back injuries for
caregivers and first responders. It provides secure grip points and a broad contact area on the
patient, enabling lifters to maintain proper posture and distribute weight effectively.

This design minimizes awkward bending and twisting, protecting the spine from strain during
transfers. The belt enhances both professional safety and patient dignity.
* **Enhanced Weight Distribution**: Doty Belt spreads the patient's weight, preventing concentrated
  stress on the lifter's lower back.
* **Proper Lifting Mechanics for Safer Spine Posture**: It encourages the use of powerful leg and
  core muscles, promoting a neutral spinal position.
* **Better Grip & Control for Safer Lifts**: Multiple handles offer a secure hold, reducing strain
  and facilitating controlled lifts.

# Welcome to OnPatient

The easy way to manage your personal health records

[Sign Up][4] [COVID-19 Updates][5]

## Take control of your medical records.

Securely connect with all your medical providers with OnPatient, trusted by over 13 million users.
Gain access to your information via web or the OnPatient App.

[[Onpatient patient portal on ipad, iphone, or web]][6]

## How to Connect

[envelope show to send email invite to patients to access Onpatient icon]

#### STEP 1

Ask your provider to send you an email invite to the OnPatient Portal.

[Check list on how to sign up icon]

#### STEP 2

Open the OnPatient invite email, press the “sign up” button and register online.

[ipad and iphone downloading app icon]

#### STEP 3

[Download][7] the OnPatient app from the Apple App Store.

[continual user icon]

#### STEP 4

Launch the OnPatient app and log in to connect to your medical provider.

## Through the OnPatient portal, you can
* Fill out any paperwork before your appointment to make checking in easier
* View your upcoming appointments and check-in online
* Schedule and cancel appointments from your computer or mobile device
* Message your doctor through a HIPAA compliant portal
* Manage your contact and insurance information
* Access your medical record
* Have educational material sent directly to your account
* Connect your child's account and manage their health record with yours
* View statements and pay online

* Each practice personalizes OnPatient, some of these features may not be available.

# Treaton — Your Trusted Partner in Medical Equipment for Anesthesiology and Intensive Care

Treaton (Triton Electronic Systems Ltd.) is a leading Russian manufacturer specializing in the
development, production, and full-service support of high-tech medical equipment for anesthesiology,
intensive care units (ICU), resuscitation, and emergency medicine. With more than 35 years of
experience, we deliver reliable, innovative, and safe solutions that medical professionals trust
every day.

Our equipment is successfully used by leading medical institutions, including the Ministry of
Health, Ministry of Internal Affairs, Ministry of Defense, and Ministry of Emergency Situations of
the Russian Federation, as well as by partners in over 40 countries worldwide.

## Comprehensive Range of Medical Equipment

### Mechanical Ventilators and Respiratory Support Systems

We manufacture a wide range of modern ventilators designed for intensive care, transport, and
emergency situations. Our devices support both invasive and non-invasive ventilation for adult,
pediatric, and neonatal patients.

#### ZisLine MV350 — Advanced ICU Ventilator

High-performance intensive care ventilator with advanced ventilation modes and excellent monitoring
capabilities.

#### ZisLine T100 — Portable Transport Ventilator

Compact and reliable transport ventilator ideal for ambulances, intra-hospital transport, and
emergency medical services.

### Patient Monitoring Systems

Treaton offers high-precision patient monitors and central monitoring stations that provide
real-time monitoring of vital signs in operating rooms and intensive care units.

### OEM Modules and Components

We develop and supply advanced OEM solutions for medical device manufacturers, including:

#### Mainstream and Sidestream Gas Analysis Modules

High-accuracy CO₂, O₂, and anesthetic gas monitoring sensors for integration into anesthesia
machines and ventilators.

#### Depth of Anesthesia and Sedation Monitoring Modules

Advanced Brain Activity Index (AI) monitoring technology for safe and effective procedural sedation
and general anesthesia.

## Why Medical Institutions Choose Treaton

### Proven Quality and International Certification

All Treaton equipment undergoes strict quality control and meets international standards. Our
products are certified and regularly tested in real clinical conditions.

### Innovation Backed by 35 Years of Experience

#### Advanced Technologies Developed In-House

Our key developments include indirect calorimetry for metabolic assessment and unique non-invasive
hemodynamic monitoring technologies.

#### Continuous Research and Development

We constantly improve our products by implementing the latest achievements in biomedical engineering
and respiratory support.

### Reliable Service and Technical Support

We provide full lifecycle support for our equipment:

#### Warranty and Post-Warranty Maintenance

#### Extended Warranty Programs

#### Professional Training for Biomedical Engineers

#### 24/7 Technical Consultation and Prompt Repair Service

### Professional Team Dedicated to Your Success

Our team consists of experienced engineers, developers, anesthesiologists, and international sales
specialists who work closely with each client to deliver the best technical and commercial
solutions.

## Customized OEM Solutions for Medical Device Manufacturers

Treaton is a reliable OEM partner offering high-precision gas analysis modules, sedation monitoring
systems, and other critical components. We help manufacturers enhance their equipment with
cutting-edge technology while reducing development time and costs.

## Partner with Treaton Today

Contact our team to learn more about our full range of medical ventilators, patient monitors, OEM
modules, and comprehensive service programs. We are ready to provide tailored solutions that
perfectly match the needs of your hospital, clinic, or manufacturing project.

**Treaton — Advanced Medical Technology • Reliable Performance • Professional Support • 35 Years of
Excellence**

[Building a Cost-Effective Mobility Equipment Fleet: A Procurement Framework][53]2026-05-07

Smart procurement managers build balanced fleets of transfer chairs, toilet lift chairs, and
electric transfer chairs. Learn the framework for right-sizing your mobility equipment inventory.

[Battery Life and Charging Best Practices for Electric Transfer Chair Fleets][54]2026-05-04

An electric transfer chair offers tremendous benefits for caregiver safety and patient comfort. But
those benefits depend entirely on reliable battery performance. A electric transfer chair with a
dead battery is just a heavy manual chair.

[Essential Features to Look for in a Patient Transfer Chair for Emergency Departments][55]2026-04-30

Emergency departments place unique demands on a patient transfer chair. Unlike other hospital areas,
the ED requires rapid, frequent, and often urgent patient moves. A patient transfer chair in this
setting must be ready for anything from a routine discharge to a critical transfer to imaging.

[Comparing Hydraulic vs Electric Toilet Lift Chair Models for Nursing Homes][56]2026-04-27

When selecting a toilet lift chair for a nursing home, one of the first decisions is power source.
Should you choose hydraulic or electric? Each type of toilet lift chair has distinct advantages for
different care settings. At Xiang Fa Li Technology, we manufacture both versions as part of our
complete mobility equipment line. We also produce the transfer chair, patient transfer chair, and
electric transfer chair. Understanding the trade-offs helps procurement managers make better
decisions.

[What Is the Pressure Redistribution Capability of Silicone Mattresses?]
What Is the Pressure Redistribution Capability of Silicone Mattresses?

Pressure redistribution is one of the most critical functions of any medical mattress, especially in
intensive care units (ICUs), long-term care facilities, and wards with high-risk or immobile
patients. Silicone mattresses have gained wide recognition in the medical field because of their
exceptional pressure redistribution capability, helping reduce the risk of pressure injuries, skin
breakdown, and discomfort during long periods of hospitalization.

Keeping a silicone hospital mattress clean and properly disinfected is essential for protecting
patients from healthcare-associated infections (HAIs), cross-contamination, and skin complications
such as pressure ulcers.

TENA, a brand of Essity - a global, leading hygiene and health company. Everyday, our products,
solutions, and services are used by a billion people around the world. Our purpose is to break
barriers to well-being for the benefit of consumers, patients, caregivers, customers, and society.
Sales are conducted in approximately 150 countries under the leading global brands TENA and Tork,
and other strong brands such as Actimove, Cutimed, JOBST, Knix, Leukoplast, Libero, Libresse, Lotus,
Modibodi, Nosotras, Saba, Tempo, TOM Organic, and Zewa. In 2025, Essity had net sales of
approximately SEK 138bn (EUR 13bn) and employed 36,000 people. The company’s headquarters is located
in Stockholm, Sweden, and Essity is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. More information at
[www.essity.com][70].

## Healthcare Professionals

Committed to helping you enhance your practice and the experience of your patients through connected
devices and digitalised data sharing.

  Supporting every aspect of your clinical practice, including physical exam, diagnostic cardiology,
  vitals monitoring and vision screening
* [ Hospital Care ][11]
  
  Advancing products and technologies designed to speed patient recovery and streamline clinical
  workflows
* [ Surgical Care ][12]
  
  Delivering innovations that enable reduced operating times, faster patient recovery and improved
  outcomes
* [ Nutritional Care ][13]
  
  Personalizing nutritional care designed to improve patients’ health in the hospital, the ICU and
  at home
* [ Respiratory Health ][14]
  
  Helping your patients with respiratory therapies designed to simplify delivery and improve
  mobility

  Our portfolio of acute, nutritional, hospital and surgical care products helps advance healthcare
  around the world.

## Perspectives

For nearly a century, we have worked at the intersection of saving and sustaining lives.

  We are a community of diverse professionals working together to drive better healthcare options.

  Enriching the communities where we live and work.

## Our Story

Our 90-year heritage gives us distinct perspective on the needs of patients and caregivers. We lead
today by putting those insights to work to deliver new, better healthcare solutions and access to
care in the communities where we live and work.

[Our Story][21]
* [ Our Leadership ][22]
  
  Our forward-looking leadership team is a driving force in ensuring we meet the needs of all our
  stakeholders – every day and everywhere.
* [ Our Governance ][23]
  
  We are proud of our strong commitment to maintaining the highest standards of corporate
  governance.
* [ Fueling Collaborative Innovation ][24]
  
  Nurturing a culture of innovation is critical to delivering on our mission to save and sustain
  lives. We partner with the healthcare community to continually find more efficient, smarter ways
  to help solve the world's most pressing healthcare challenges.
* [ Baxter Sustainability ][25]
  
  We strive to create lasting value by delivering sustainable healthcare, advancing climate and
  resiliency, and championing our people and communities.
* [ Inclusion & Diversity ][26]
  
  We are committed to attracting, motivating and retaining an inclusive and diverse workforce.
* [ Our History ][27]
  
  For nearly a century, we’ve been focused on saving and sustaining lives and elevating patient
  care.

## Patients

Helping you reach a healthy life, full of possibility.

[Patients][28]
* [ General Healthcare ][29]
  
  Whether you are receiving care in the hospital, at your doctor’s office or at home, we are here to
  support every step of your journey.
* [ Nutritional Care ][30]
  
  When medical conditions prevent you from adequately feeding yourself, we provide life-saving
  clinical nutrition options to help you regain your nutritional status.
* [ Respiratory Health ][31]
  
  We are committed to helping you with innovative products that deliver effective, proven
  respiratory therapy in the hospital and at home.

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

# Welcome to Disability Hoist Hire

Welcome to Disability Hoist Hire, the patient lifting equipment rental and training specialists.
Disability Hoist Hire offer **short** and **long** term **hoist hire** - a cost effective way to
meet your **manual handling needs**. **Hoist training** can also be provided for individuals or

## Social Care

The health and social care sector are amongst the highest risk areas for back injuries at work.
Approximately half of all accidents reported in these sectors happen to workers assisting or moving
individuals with mobility problems. Manual handling injuries are, however, preventable. Our
specialist advisors will be able to provide you with assistance whilst choosing your hoist.

[Risk and Danger Icon]

## Prevent Risks

Individuals with mobility problems are heavy and unpredictable loads and, therefore, workers
handling patients with mobility problems are covered by the Manual Handling Regulations 1992. These
Regulations say that employers **MUST:** Avoid manual handling wherever possible, Assess the risks
and reduce them as far as is reasonably practicable.

house and enjoy living again.

## Social Care

The health and social care sector are amongst the highest risk areas for back injuries at work.
Approximately half of all accidents reported in these sectors happen to workers assisting or moving
individuals with mobility problems. Manual handling injuries are, however, preventable. Our
specialist advisors will be able to provide you with assistance whilst choosing your hoist.

[Risk and Danger Icon]

## Prevent Risks

Individuals with mobility problems are heavy and unpredictable loads and, therefore, workers
handling patients with mobility problems are covered by the Manual Handling Regulations 1992. These
Regulations say that employers **MUST:** Avoid manual handling wherever possible, Assess the risks
and reduce them as far as is reasonably practicable.

## How Doty Belt Reduces Back Injuries

The Doty Belt is an ergonomic patient lift assist that significantly reduces back injuries for
caregivers and first responders. It provides secure grip points and a broad contact area on the
patient, enabling lifters to maintain proper posture and distribute weight effectively.

This design minimizes awkward bending and twisting, protecting the spine from strain during
transfers. The belt enhances both professional safety and patient dignity.
* **Enhanced Weight Distribution**: Doty Belt spreads the patient's weight, preventing concentrated
  stress on the lifter's lower back.
* **Proper Lifting Mechanics for Safer Spine Posture**: It encourages the use of powerful leg and
  core muscles, promoting a neutral spinal position.
* **Better Grip & Control for Safer Lifts**: Multiple handles offer a secure hold, reducing strain
  and facilitating controlled lifts.

Developed by retired California Fire Captain Glen Doty after 30 years of emergency response
experience, the Doty Belt emerged from a challenging real-world scenario where his crew struggled to
safely lift a patient from the ground to her wheelchair.

The resulting product combines practical field experience with rigorous safety engineering, creating
a tool that has been tested to UL standards and can handle up to 1,700 pounds of tensile force.

Captain Doty is also an accomplished entrepreneur, having founded the company
[Heroes Mushroom Coffee][53], providing a specialized coffee brew for individuals who desire more
than just the typical coffee benefits.

AI agents handle drafts, code generation, research, and documentation. But there's a disconnect
that's slowing everything down: the place where your team thinks, plans, and refines their work
isn't the same place your agents can access it.

###### What's missing is a shared layer

Your team and your agents should always be working from the same source of truth, a place where the
team sets direction, agents contribute, and everything stays aligned as ideas move from rough draft
to polished output ready to ship.

It's not just a collaboration tool for your team, but the shared context layer that keeps your team
and your agents in sync. Your team refines ideas in one place, agents pull from that same place, and
when agents contribute something back, it lands right where the team can review, edit, and build on
it together.

team already counts on, every day.

Every edit, every comment, every revision is tracked and recoverable, so your team's thinking isn't
just captured in the final draft but in the full history of how you got there. That means onboarding
someone new, revisiting a past decision, or understanding why something changed is never more than a
scroll through the version timeline.

Explore features][19]

#### Built for how communities actually work

From hackathons and research groups to open-source projects, study groups, and devnets, HackMD has
been the working surface for communities that build knowledge in the open.
* Public notes
* [Shared workspaces][20]
* [Embeds][21]
* [Slide mode][22]

to gather around ideas, engage with each other's work, and grow together, whether that's ten
contributors or ten thousand.

See community stories][23]

docs, and team knowledge through the same URLs your team uses.

* Push agent-generated drafts back into your workspace
* Agent gets Markdown via Accept: text/markdown
Markdown content uses up to 80% fewer tokens than the equivalent HTML, so your agents spend their
compute on the actual work, reducing cost for your team.

# Welcome to OnPatient

The easy way to manage your personal health records

[Sign Up][4] [COVID-19 Updates][5]

## Take control of your medical records.

Securely connect with all your medical providers with OnPatient, trusted by over 13 million users.
Gain access to your information via web or the OnPatient App.

[[Onpatient patient portal on ipad, iphone, or web]][6]

## How to Connect

[envelope show to send email invite to patients to access Onpatient icon]

#### STEP 1

Ask your provider to send you an email invite to the OnPatient Portal.

[Check list on how to sign up icon]

#### STEP 2

Open the OnPatient invite email, press the “sign up” button and register online.

[ipad and iphone downloading app icon]

#### STEP 3

[Download][7] the OnPatient app from the Apple App Store.

[continual user icon]

#### STEP 4

Launch the OnPatient app and log in to connect to your medical provider.

## Through the OnPatient portal, you can
* Fill out any paperwork before your appointment to make checking in easier
* View your upcoming appointments and check-in online
* Schedule and cancel appointments from your computer or mobile device
* Message your doctor through a HIPAA compliant portal
* Manage your contact and insurance information
* Access your medical record
* Have educational material sent directly to your account
* Connect your child's account and manage their health record with yours
* View statements and pay online

* Each practice personalizes OnPatient, some of these features may not be available.

About Palma Airport

Palma de Mallorca Airport (PMI), also known as Son Sant Joan Airport, is the gateway to the
wonderful island of Mallorca. It’s the place where most people begin and end their holiday. Palma
Airport is the **third-largest** airport in Spain, with close to** 34 million passengers every
year**, dispatching **more than 12,000 passengers per hour** during busy periods. In the peak summer
months, this dual-runway airport handles as many movements as Heathrow, the busiest airport in
Europe.

practical guidance on travel to and from the airport. We aim to provide** clear, relevant, and

# Treaton — Your Trusted Partner in Medical Equipment for Anesthesiology and Intensive Care

Treaton (Triton Electronic Systems Ltd.) is a leading Russian manufacturer specializing in the
development, production, and full-service support of high-tech medical equipment for anesthesiology,
intensive care units (ICU), resuscitation, and emergency medicine. With more than 35 years of
experience, we deliver reliable, innovative, and safe solutions that medical professionals trust
every day.

Our equipment is successfully used by leading medical institutions, including the Ministry of
Health, Ministry of Internal Affairs, Ministry of Defense, and Ministry of Emergency Situations of
the Russian Federation, as well as by partners in over 40 countries worldwide.

## Comprehensive Range of Medical Equipment

### Mechanical Ventilators and Respiratory Support Systems

We manufacture a wide range of modern ventilators designed for intensive care, transport, and
emergency situations. Our devices support both invasive and non-invasive ventilation for adult,
pediatric, and neonatal patients.

#### ZisLine MV350 — Advanced ICU Ventilator

High-performance intensive care ventilator with advanced ventilation modes and excellent monitoring
capabilities.

#### ZisLine T100 — Portable Transport Ventilator

Compact and reliable transport ventilator ideal for ambulances, intra-hospital transport, and
emergency medical services.

### Patient Monitoring Systems

Treaton offers high-precision patient monitors and central monitoring stations that provide
real-time monitoring of vital signs in operating rooms and intensive care units.

### OEM Modules and Components

We develop and supply advanced OEM solutions for medical device manufacturers, including:

#### Mainstream and Sidestream Gas Analysis Modules

High-accuracy CO₂, O₂, and anesthetic gas monitoring sensors for integration into anesthesia
machines and ventilators.

#### Depth of Anesthesia and Sedation Monitoring Modules

Advanced Brain Activity Index (AI) monitoring technology for safe and effective procedural sedation
and general anesthesia.

## Why Medical Institutions Choose Treaton

### Proven Quality and International Certification

All Treaton equipment undergoes strict quality control and meets international standards. Our
products are certified and regularly tested in real clinical conditions.

### Innovation Backed by 35 Years of Experience

#### Advanced Technologies Developed In-House

Our key developments include indirect calorimetry for metabolic assessment and unique non-invasive
hemodynamic monitoring technologies.

#### Continuous Research and Development

We constantly improve our products by implementing the latest achievements in biomedical engineering
and respiratory support.

### Reliable Service and Technical Support

We provide full lifecycle support for our equipment:

#### Warranty and Post-Warranty Maintenance

#### Extended Warranty Programs

#### Professional Training for Biomedical Engineers

#### 24/7 Technical Consultation and Prompt Repair Service

### Professional Team Dedicated to Your Success

Our team consists of experienced engineers, developers, anesthesiologists, and international sales
specialists who work closely with each client to deliver the best technical and commercial
solutions.

## Customized OEM Solutions for Medical Device Manufacturers

Treaton is a reliable OEM partner offering high-precision gas analysis modules, sedation monitoring
systems, and other critical components. We help manufacturers enhance their equipment with
cutting-edge technology while reducing development time and costs.

## Partner with Treaton Today

Contact our team to learn more about our full range of medical ventilators, patient monitors, OEM
modules, and comprehensive service programs. We are ready to provide tailored solutions that
perfectly match the needs of your hospital, clinic, or manufacturing project.

**Treaton — Advanced Medical Technology • Reliable Performance • Professional Support • 35 Years of
Excellence**

[Building a Cost-Effective Mobility Equipment Fleet: A Procurement Framework][53]2026-05-07

Smart procurement managers build balanced fleets of transfer chairs, toilet lift chairs, and
electric transfer chairs. Learn the framework for right-sizing your mobility equipment inventory.

[Battery Life and Charging Best Practices for Electric Transfer Chair Fleets][54]2026-05-04

An electric transfer chair offers tremendous benefits for caregiver safety and patient comfort. But
those benefits depend entirely on reliable battery performance. A electric transfer chair with a
dead battery is just a heavy manual chair.

[Essential Features to Look for in a Patient Transfer Chair for Emergency Departments][55]2026-04-30

Emergency departments place unique demands on a patient transfer chair. Unlike other hospital areas,
the ED requires rapid, frequent, and often urgent patient moves. A patient transfer chair in this
setting must be ready for anything from a routine discharge to a critical transfer to imaging.

[Comparing Hydraulic vs Electric Toilet Lift Chair Models for Nursing Homes][56]2026-04-27

When selecting a toilet lift chair for a nursing home, one of the first decisions is power source.
Should you choose hydraulic or electric? Each type of toilet lift chair has distinct advantages for
different care settings. At Xiang Fa Li Technology, we manufacture both versions as part of our
complete mobility equipment line. We also produce the transfer chair, patient transfer chair, and
electric transfer chair. Understanding the trade-offs helps procurement managers make better
decisions.

[What Is the Pressure Redistribution Capability of Silicone Mattresses?]
What Is the Pressure Redistribution Capability of Silicone Mattresses?

Pressure redistribution is one of the most critical functions of any medical mattress, especially in
intensive care units (ICUs), long-term care facilities, and wards with high-risk or immobile
patients. Silicone mattresses have gained wide recognition in the medical field because of their
exceptional pressure redistribution capability, helping reduce the risk of pressure injuries, skin
breakdown, and discomfort during long periods of hospitalization.

How Do You Clean and Disinfect a Silicone Hospital Mattress?

Keeping a silicone hospital mattress clean and properly disinfected is essential for protecting
patients from healthcare-associated infections (HAIs), cross-contamination, and skin complications
such as pressure ulcers.
